usedFor: A new WooCommerce customer gets an onboarding call set up in Calendly.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer Created” in WooCommerce, then “Create One-Time Meeting” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer is when a welcome call makes sense, unlike coupon or product triggers.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” also reaches this action, so an edited profile could create another meeting.
